note: A LETTER IS A TEMPLATE HERE, NOT A CONTROLLER AND NOT A WORD FILE ON SOMEBODY'S DESKTOP. Each template names the subject it is written about, the placeholders it needs, and its body. {{field}} pulls from the employee; {{field|money}} formats it as rupees, {{field|money_words}} as rupees in words, {{field|date}} as a date an Indian reader expects, {{field|upper}} in capitals. {{effective_date}} is the effective date HR picks when drafting (today if none). A placeholder that resolves to NOTHING is a refusal, not a blank — an appointment letter issued with an empty salary line is worse than one that failed to issue, because it is signed. Required placeholders are listed so the refusal can name what is missing before anybody reads the draft.

TO WHOMSOEVER IT MAY CONCERN

This is to certify that {{name|upper}}, employee code {{emp_code}}, was employed with {{company}} as {{designation}} in the {{department}} department from {{doj|date}}.

We wish {{name}} success in future endeavours.

For {{company}}

letters.label: NDA / Confidentiality undertaking
letters.subject: employees
letters.body:
{{today|date}}

CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-DISCLOSURE UNDERTAKING

I, {{name|upper}}, employee code {{emp_code}}, employed with {{company}} as {{designation}} in the {{department}} department, undertake as follows:

1. I shall hold in strict confidence all information relating to the company, its clients, borrowers, customers, accounts, business methods, systems and data that comes to my knowledge in the course of my employee.

2. I shall not disclose, copy, remove or use any such information for any purpose other than the discharge of my duties, during or after my employee.

3. I shall return every document, device and record belonging to the company on the last day of my service.

4. I understand that a breach of this undertaking may lead to disciplinary action, termination and legal proceedings.

Signed at {{branch}} on {{today|date}}.


____________________
{{name}}

Witnessed for {{company}}
Authorised Signatory
